card.name: Linking words before a predictable medical term
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas, spaces or word starts (the, or, to, of, co) in drug-label text, right where a specific medical term comes next (colectomy, nephrolithiasis, ascending). Also a space between a section number and a dose.

modes.label: Linking word before a term
modes.description: A small word such as the, or, to or of sits just before an expected clinical word.
modes.example: refractory<< to>> antimicrobial therapy and may require colect

modes.label: Space in section or dose lists
modes.description: A blank space after a bracketed section number, before the next number or dose.

modes.label: Partway through a medical word
modes.description: The pole fires on the start of a longer clinical word.
modes.example: may require<< co>>lectomy. CDAD must be considered
